decisions.reason: This compact dumper extends the firm's established construction line, is still shown on its own page, and costs little to keep while its market value is still unresolved.
The articulated dumper is a core-adjacent product with ongoing visibility, so it is a cheap option worth holding while demand evidence accumulates.

The rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and has been downgraded from its own page to a mention, which signals weakening value, but niche mining safety demand may still resolve favourably and carrying it costs little.
The compact telescopic loader builds on established competences and remains presented on its own page, so the option is still open at low cost.
The material lift shows resolved positive value, being the most popular lift in rental with a recent large order, so there is no reason to drop it.
The underground mining loader has strong early field results of 1,000 operating hours in 7 months, so its value is materializing and further commitment is justified.
